<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_FarmingBot"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Brag" name="Brag"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Materials" name="Materials"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CreateBot" name="Begin creating bot">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_SelectResources</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectResources" name="Select resources to farm">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_SelectResources</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_SetPriorities</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SetPriorities" name="Set resource priorities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_SetPriorities</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Priorities_ConfigureDependencies</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfigureDependencies" name="Configure tool and resource dependencies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Priorities_ConfigureDependencies</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Dependencies_StartBot</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_StartBot" name="Start farming bot">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Dependencies_StartBot</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartBot_FarmResources</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FarmResources" name="Farm selected resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartBot_FarmResources</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Farm_ChooseActions</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">min(selectedResourceCount, 10)</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseActions" name="Choose post-farming actions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Farm_ChooseActions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Choose_SplitActions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" name="Select post-farming actions" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Choose_SplitActions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Brag</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_SendMaterials</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_NoAction</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Brag">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Brag</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Brag_JoinActions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Materials">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_SendMaterials</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendMaterials_JoinActions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostActionsJoin" name="Complete selected actions" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Brag_JoinActions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendMaterials_JoinActions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_NoAction</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FarmingBot" name="Farming bot process complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_UpdateList" name="Update farming list" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_UpdateList" name="Farming list update requested" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateStart_UpdateList</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_UpdateList">
          <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farmingListUpdateRequested</bpmn:condition>
        </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateList" name="Update list of materials to farm">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateStart_UpdateList</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateList_UpdateEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_UpdateList" name="Farming list updated">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateList_UpdateEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateStart_UpdateList" sourceRef="StartEvent_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_UpdateList"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateList_UpdateEnd" sourceRef="Task_UpdateList" targetRef="EndEvent_UpdateList"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_Disaster" name="Handle natural disaster" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Disaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DisasterStart_Setback</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_Disaster">
          <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">naturalDisasterOccurs</bpmn:condition>
        </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplySetback" name="Apply farming setback">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DisasterStart_Setback</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Setback_DisasterEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Disaster" name="Setback applied">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Setback_DisasterEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DisasterStart_Setback" sourceRef="StartEvent_Disaster" targetRef="Task_ApplySetback"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Setback_DisasterEnd" sourceRef="Task_ApplySetback" targetRef="EndEvent_Disaster"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_Milestone" name="Notify on milestones" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Milestone" name="Milestone reached" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MilestoneStart_Notify</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_Milestone">
          <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farmingMilestoneReached</bpmn:condition>
        </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MilestoneStart_Notify</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notify_MilestoneEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Milestone" name="Milestone notification sent">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notify_MilestoneEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MilestoneStart_Notify" sourceRef="StartEvent_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_MilestoneEnd" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="EndEvent_Milestone"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_SelectResources" sourceRef="StartEvent_CreateBot" targetRef="Task_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_SetPriorities" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Task_SetPriorities"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Priorities_ConfigureDependencies" sourceRef="Task_SetPriorities" targetRef="Task_ConfigureDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dependencies_StartBot" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureDependencies" targetRef="Task_StartBot"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartBot_FarmResources" sourceRef="Task_StartBot" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_ChooseActions" sourceRef="Task_FarmResources" targetRef="Task_ChooseActions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choose_SplitActions" sourceRef="Task_ChooseActions" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Brag" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">bragSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_SendMaterials" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">sendMaterialsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_NoAction" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not bragSelected and not sendMaterialsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_JoinActions" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendMaterials_JoinActions" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_FarmingBot"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FarmingBot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot Process" processRef="Process_FarmingBot"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SelectedFriends" name="Selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Brag" name="Brag" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends" messageRef="Message_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Materials" name="Materials" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends" messageRef="Message_Materials"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_FarmingBot"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Brag" name="Brag"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Materials" name="Materials"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FarmingBot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_CreateBot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetPriorities</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfigureDependencies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_UpdateRequested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChoosePostActions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostActionsSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ProcessComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FarmingBot" name="Farming bot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StartFarming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FarmResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FarmingEvents</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_MilestoneReached</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMilestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_DisasterStrikes</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplySetback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_FarmingFinished</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CreateBot" name="Begin creating a farming bot">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_SelectResources</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectResources" name="Select resources to farm">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_SelectResources</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_SetPriorities</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPriorities" name="Set resource urgency priorities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_SetPriorities</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Priorities_ConfigureDependencies</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConfigureDependencies" name="Configure tool and resource dependencies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Priorities_ConfigureDependencies</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Dependencies_StartFarming</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_StartFarming" name="Start farming bot">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Dependencies_StartFarming</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartFarming_Farm</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FarmResources" name="Farm selected resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartFarming_Farm</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notify_ResumeFarming</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Setback_ResumeFarming</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Update_ResumeFarming</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Farm_FarmingEvents</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">min(selectedResourceCount, 10)</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_FarmingEvents" name="Wait for farming event" gatewayDirection="Diverging" eventGatewayType="Exclusive">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Farm_FarmingEvents</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Events_Milestone</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Events_Disaster</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Events_Update</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Events_Finished</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_MilestoneReached" name="Farming milestone reached">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Events_Milestone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Milestone_Notify</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_Milestone">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farmingMilestoneReached</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Milestone_Notify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notify_ResumeFarming</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DisasterStrikes" name="Random natural disaster strikes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Events_Disaster</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disaster_Setback</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_Disaster">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">naturalDisasterOccurs</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplySetback" name="Set farming bot back">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disaster_Setback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Setback_ResumeFarming</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_UpdateRequested" name="Farming list update requested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Events_Update</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Update_UpdateList</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_Update">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farmingListUpdateRequested</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateList" name="Update list of materials to farm">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Update_UpdateList</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Update_ResumeFarming</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FarmingFinished" name="Farming bot finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Events_Finished</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Finished_ChooseActions</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_Finished">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farmingFinished</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChoosePostActions" name="Choose whether to brag and/or send materials">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Finished_ChooseActions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChooseActions_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" name="Select post-farming actions" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_Split_NoAction">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChooseActions_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Brag</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_SendMaterials</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_NoAction</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Brag">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Brag</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Brag_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Materials">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_SendMaterials</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendMaterials_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostActionsJoin" name="Complete selected post-farming actions" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Brag_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendMaterials_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_NoAction</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProcessComplete" name="Farming bot process complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_SelectResources" sourceRef="StartEvent_CreateBot" targetRef="Task_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_SetPriorities" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Task_SetPriorities"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Priorities_ConfigureDependencies" sourceRef="Task_SetPriorities" targetRef="Task_ConfigureDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dependencies_StartFarming" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureDependencies" targetRef="Task_StartFarming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartFarming_Farm" sourceRef="Task_StartFarming" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_FarmingEvents" sourceRef="Task_FarmResources" targetRef="Gateway_FarmingEvents"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Events_Milestone" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmingEvents" targetRef="Event_MilestoneReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Events_Disaster" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmingEvents" targetRef="Event_DisasterStrikes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Events_Update" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmingEvents" targetRef="Event_UpdateRequested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Events_Finished" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmingEvents" targetRef="Event_FarmingFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_Notify" sourceRef="Event_MilestoneReached" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_ResumeFarming" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_Setback" sourceRef="Event_DisasterStrikes" targetRef="Task_ApplySetback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Setback_ResumeFarming" sourceRef="Task_ApplySetback" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_UpdateList" sourceRef="Event_UpdateRequested" targetRef="Task_UpdateList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_ResumeFarming" sourceRef="Task_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Finished_ChooseActions" sourceRef="Event_FarmingFinished" targetRef="Task_ChoosePostActions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChooseActions_Split" sourceRef="Task_ChoosePostActions" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Brag" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">bragSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_SendMaterials" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">sendMaterialsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_NoAction" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_Join" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendMaterials_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FarmingBot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_FarmingBot" name="Farming bot process" processRef="Process_FarmingBot"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SelectedFriends" name="Selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Brag" name="Brag" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends" messageRef="Message_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Materials" name="Materials" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends" messageRef="Message_Materials"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_FarmingBot"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Brag" name="Brag"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Materials" name="Materials"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FarmingBot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_CreateBot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetPriorities</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfigureDependencies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChoosePostActions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostActionsSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_FarmingBot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Bot" name="Farming bot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StartBot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FarmResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_Disaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplySetback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Disaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMilestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CreateBot" name="Begin creating bot">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_SelectResources</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectResources" name="Select resources to farm">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_SelectResources</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_SetPriorities</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPriorities" name="Set resource priorities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_SetPriorities</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Priorities_ConfigureDependencies</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConfigureDependencies" name="Configure tool and resource dependencies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Priorities_ConfigureDependencies</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Dependencies_StartBot</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_StartBot" name="Start farming bot">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Dependencies_StartBot</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartBot_FarmResources</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FarmResources" name="Farm selected resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartBot_FarmResources</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Farm_ChooseActions</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">min(selectedResourceCount, 10)</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_UpdateList" name="Farming list update requested" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateListRequested_UpdateList</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_UpdateList">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farmingListUpdateRequested</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateList" name="Update list of materials to farm">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateListRequested_UpdateList</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateList_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_UpdateList" name="Farming list updated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateList_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_Disaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disaster_Setback</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_Disaster">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">naturalDisasterOccurs</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplySetback" name="Apply setback to farming progress">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disaster_Setback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Setback_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Disaster" name="Farming setback applied">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Setback_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_Milestone" name="Farming milestone reached" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Milestone_Notify</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_Milestone">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farmingMilestoneReached</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Milestone_Notify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notify_MilestoneEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Milestone" name="Milestone notification sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notify_MilestoneEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChoosePostActions" name="Choose post-farming actions and friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Farm_ChooseActions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChooseActions_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" name="Select post-farming actions" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_PostActions_NoAction">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChooseActions_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PostActions_Brag</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PostActions_SendMaterials</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PostActions_NoAction</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PostActions_Brag</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Brag_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PostActions_SendMaterials</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendMaterials_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostActionsJoin" name="Complete selected actions" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Brag_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendMaterials_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PostActions_NoAction</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PostActions_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FarmingBot" name="Farming bot process complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PostActions_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_SelectResources" sourceRef="StartEvent_CreateBot" targetRef="Task_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_SetPriorities" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Task_SetPriorities"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Priorities_ConfigureDependencies" sourceRef="Task_SetPriorities" targetRef="Task_ConfigureDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dependencies_StartBot" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureDependencies" targetRef="Task_StartBot"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartBot_FarmResources" sourceRef="Task_StartBot" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_ChooseActions" sourceRef="Task_FarmResources" targetRef="Task_ChoosePostActions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateListRequested_UpdateList" sourceRef="Boundary_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_UpdateList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateList_End" sourceRef="Task_UpdateList" targetRef="EndEvent_UpdateList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_Setback" sourceRef="Boundary_Disaster" targetRef="Task_ApplySetback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Setback_End" sourceRef="Task_ApplySetback" targetRef="EndEvent_Disaster"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_Notify" sourceRef="Boundary_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_MilestoneEnd" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="EndEvent_Milestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChooseActions_Split" sourceRef="Task_ChoosePostActions" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostActions_Brag" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">bragSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostActions_SendMaterials" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">sendMaterialsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostActions_NoAction" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_Join" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendMaterials_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostActions_End" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_FarmingBot"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FarmingBot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot Process" processRef="Process_FarmingBot"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SelectedFriends" name="Selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Brag" name="Brag" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends" messageRef="Message_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Materials" name="Materials" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends" messageRef="Message_Materials"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_FarmingBot"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Materials" name="Materials for selected friends"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FarmingBot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_CreateBot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetPriorities</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfigureDependencies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseActions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostActionsSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_FarmingBot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FarmingBot" name="Farming bot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FarmResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_Disaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplySetback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_SetbackApplied</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMilestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_MilestoneNotified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CreateBot" name="Begin creating a farming bot">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_SelectResources</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectResources" name="Select resources to farm">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_SelectResources</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_SetPriorities</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPriorities" name="Set resource priorities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_SetPriorities</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Priorities_ConfigureDependencies</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConfigureDependencies" name="Configure tool and resource dependencies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Priorities_ConfigureDependencies</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Dependencies_FarmResources</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FarmResources" name="Farm selected resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Dependencies_FarmResources</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Farm_ChooseActions</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">min(selectedResourceCount, 10)</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_Disaster" name="Natural disaster strikes during farming" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disaster_ApplySetback</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_Disaster">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">naturalDisasterOccurs</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplySetback" name="Apply farming setback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disaster_ApplySetback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Setback_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SetbackApplied" name="Farming setback applied">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Setback_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_Milestone" name="Farming milestone reached" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Milestone_Notify</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_Milestone">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farmingMilestoneReached</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Milestone_Notify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notify_MilestoneEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MilestoneNotified" name="Milestone notification sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notify_MilestoneEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_UpdateList" name="Player requests farming list update" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateList_UpdateTask</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_UpdateList">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farmingListUpdateRequested</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateList" name="Update list of materials to farm">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateList_UpdateTask</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateTask_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_UpdateList" name="Farming list updated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateTask_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseActions" name="Choose post-farming actions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Farm_ChooseActions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Choose_PostActions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" name="Select post-farming actions" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Choose_PostActions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Brag</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_SendMaterials</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_NoAction</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Brag">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Brag</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Brag_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Materials">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_SendMaterials</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Materials_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostActionsJoin" name="Complete selected actions" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Brag_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Materials_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_NoAction</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PostActions_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FarmingBot" name="Farming bot process complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PostActions_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_SelectResources" sourceRef="StartEvent_CreateBot" targetRef="Task_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_SetPriorities" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Task_SetPriorities"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Priorities_ConfigureDependencies" sourceRef="Task_SetPriorities" targetRef="Task_ConfigureDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dependencies_FarmResources" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureDependencies" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_ChooseActions" sourceRef="Task_FarmResources" targetRef="Task_ChooseActions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_ApplySetback" sourceRef="Boundary_Disaster" targetRef="Task_ApplySetback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Setback_End" sourceRef="Task_ApplySetback" targetRef="EndEvent_SetbackApplied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_Notify" sourceRef="Boundary_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_MilestoneEnd" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="EndEvent_MilestoneNotified"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateList_UpdateTask" sourceRef="Boundary_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_UpdateList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateTask_End" sourceRef="Task_UpdateList" targetRef="EndEvent_UpdateList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choose_PostActions" sourceRef="Task_ChooseActions" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Brag" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">bragSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_SendMaterials" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">sendMaterialsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_NoAction" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not bragSelected and not sendMaterialsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_PostActionsJoin" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Materials_PostActionsJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostActions_End" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_FarmingBot"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FarmingBot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot Process" processRef="Process_FarmingBot"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SelectedFriends" name="Selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Brag" name="Brag" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends" messageRef="Message_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Materials" name="Materials" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends" messageRef="Message_Materials"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
